page.layout: One page of text, title page. Printed lines centred in one column; an engraving in the middle; the vertical inscriptions beside the engraving on left and right; the imprint below the engraving. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Incipiens à Christo nato, & perpetuam ducens
ac Polonia Regem HENRICVM hoc nomi-
Lex per Mosen data est : gratia & veritas per Iesum
Christum facta est. Ioan. cap. I.

page.notes: The engraving (an oval emblem of a man holding a tablet inscribed AETERNITAS/AION, with a sun above, a moon at left, two tablets of the law at right, a skull at lower left) is not transcribed as text. The tablet lettering is too small to read reliably and is left out. Hyphenation "nomi-ne" is at a line end and is kept as printed. Ioan. cap. I is printed in italics. The vertical inscriptions read NOX PRÆCESSIT (left, reading upward) and DIES SVCCESSIT (right, reading downward).
